Score Big with Online Tax Deed Sales in Medina County, Ohio

Is it still possible to buy cheap properties in this economy?!

Yes, it is! In Medina County, Ohio, tax deed sales offer a fantastic opportunity to purchase properties at potentially below-market prices. These sales are held every scheduled Thursday and conducted online via Realauction, making it convenient to participate from the comfort of your home.

How to Start Acquiring Below-Market Properties in Medina County, Ohio?

To get started, register online with Realauction and submit your deposit, which is based on the property’s appraised value. Here’s a breakdown of the deposit amounts:

  • $2,000 for properties appraised at $10,000 or less
  • $5,000 for properties appraised between $10,001 and $200,000
  • $10,000 for properties appraised over $200,000

This system ensures a fair bidding process and reflects the seriousness of your intent.

Understanding Tax Deed Sales

In tax deed sales, the bidding starts at the unpaid tax amount plus court costs. This setup can allow you to purchase properties below market rates. If the property owner doesn’t redeem the lien within the specified period, you gain ownership of the property.

FAQs

What is a tax deed sale?

  • A tax deed sale is a public auction where properties with unpaid taxes are sold. The winning bidder gets ownership of the property if the previous owner doesn’t redeem it.

How do I participate in Medina County’s tax deed sales?

  • Register online with Realauction, submit your deposit, and start bidding on the scheduled auction days.

What are the deposit requirements?

  • Deposits vary by property value: $2,000 for properties up to $10,000, $5,000 for properties between $10,001 and $200,000, and $10,000 for properties over $200,000.
